[1/1] Plan: add opt-in --full-final so the tuner scores each final preset on every task item (136 for code) instead of the 48-item search rung; keep the fast rung the default

impact_assessment.why: The 48-item search rung is a sample of the task; a final preset deserves a full-item rate so the reported score is not only a subsample.
impact_assessment.benefits: Higher-power final rate; withDiscriminatingRungs can expose the full item set without changing the default run cost.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tune CLI and task rungs; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: benchmark suite version unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: default stays the fast rung; real-engine validation on one preset; hermetic tests; tune gate on the three core models

impact_assessment.why: ADR-036 retired the thinking prompts on an underpowered first tune and the last deep-reasoning run lost at 12-37 answers; the current question is whether an abstract-thinking instruction can raise code-task performance with the v8 profile and a powered pair.
impact_assessment.benefits: A pre-registered paired verdict (McNemar) instead of slogan prompts being assumed useless; if an arm wins, it becomes a tuner prompt candidate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tuner prompt step list; dependency: real engine + model file; concurrency: measurement must not share the box with Crucible scoring; state: scratch harness only, no tracked code until a win
impact_assessment.mitigation: wait for the WSP6 scorer to exit, fixed load/sampling from the saved profile, same rung for every arm, paired exact test, full-rung confirmation before any default change

[1/1] Plan: keep state-changing routes local even for keyed LAN clients; refuse unload under a load/reply; make the dashboard Tune, benchmark baseline/full-matrix and Server dialog honest; let a fresh install import a profile

impact_assessment.why: An audit found remote key-holders could delete models and rewrite settings, unload could race a load, a dashboard mis-click launched an hours-long tune, a phase-irrelevant checkbox did nothing, a blank Server dialog could be saved, and profile import was unreachable without a profile.
impact_assessment.benefits: One safety rule across the API, no accidental full tunes or baseline overwrites, no blank-save data loss, and a fresh install can load a shared profile.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: LAN clients lose mutation rights; dependency: none; concurrency: unload now refuses instead of racing; state: no saved-data migration
impact_assessment.mitigation: route-level guard, real non-loopback socket test, busy-status test, UI + smoke tests, full suite and project gates

[1/1] Plan: measure whether any prompt or sampler change beats the accepted code preset on the served sampler, then make a sampler change re-open the prompt it was chosen with

impact_assessment.why: The saved coder profile was screened at temperature 0.7 but serves 0.4; a sampler re-tune leaves the prompt (and its stats) measured on the old sampler, so the applied preset can be unproven under the settings actually used.
impact_assessment.benefits: The saved prompt is always validated on the sampler in use; a sampling-only re-tune marks the prompt pending instead of silently serving an unproven choice.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tune progress gains sampledWith; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: extra prompt answers after a sampler change; old profiles have no signature and are untouched
impact_assessment.mitigation: paired real-engine screens first, hermetic tune tests for no-op/invalidation/re-measurement, full suite, UI smoke, project gates
